description: This file contains comprehensive tests for exception propagation in Orleans distributed system, covering exception types, stack trace preservation, serialization/deserialization failures, and cross-grain communication scenarios.

classes.name: ExceptionPropagationTests
classes.description: Test class for verifying exception propagation features in Orleans.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Base fixture for the test cluster setup.

classes.name: MessageSerializationClientObject
classes.description: Mock implementation of client object used in serialization fault tests.

methods.name: ExceptionsPropagatedFromGrainToClient
methods.description: Verifies proper propagation of various exception types from grain to client.

methods.name: BasicExceptionPropagation
methods.description: Ensures exception types are preserved during propagation.

methods.name: ExceptionContainsOriginalStackTrace
methods.description: Verifies remote stack traces are preserved in exceptions.

methods.name: ExceptionContainsOriginalStackTraceWhenRethrowingLocally
methods.description: Checks stack trace preservation when exceptions are rethrown with async/await.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationDoesNotUnwrapAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Ensures AggregateExceptions are not unwrapped during transmission.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationDoesNoFlattenAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Verifies nested AggregateExceptions maintain their structure.

methods.name: TaskCancelationPropagation
methods.description: Checks propagation of task cancellations as TaskCanceledException.

methods.name: GrainForwardingExceptionPropagation
methods.description: Validates exception propagation through grain-to-grain calls.

methods.name: GrainForwardingExceptionPropagationDoesNotUnwrapAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Ensures aggregate exceptions in grain calls are not unwrapped.

methods.name: SynchronousExceptionThrownShouldResultInFaultedTask
methods.description: Verifies synchronous exceptions turn into faulted Tasks, not thrown directly.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationForwardsEntireAggregateException
methods.description: Checks that multiple exception in faulted tasks are fully propagated.

methods.name: SynchronousAggregateExceptionThrownShouldResultInFaultedTaskWithOriginalAggregateExceptionUnmodifiedAsInnerException
methods.description: Verifies that synchronous AggregateExceptions are preserved intact in faulted Tasks.
